text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I build AI-powered Python applications that are practical, reliable, and ready for real users.

I’d be glad to help with your healthcare management system and the AI layer for the beta in 3 months. I’ve built a WhatsApp and SMS delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with full context. That project resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a 4.4/5 CSAT.

For your medical records system, I can help design the AI workflows, API integrations, and core application logic with a focus on accuracy, usability, and clean handoffs where needed. I’m comfortable working across Python, machine learning, NLP, LangChain, and Hugging Face Transformers, and I’d be happy to discuss the beta scope and priorities.
